title: bot.ability.memory.input
description: A request to the bot's memory: statements to run in one transaction, answered to the requester with bot.ability.memory.output or bot.ability.failed carrying the same id.

id.description: The requester's id for this request, echoed by the reply.
id.title: Id

statements.description: The statements, in order, run in one transaction.

items.description: One parameterized statement, passed to the engine unchanged: the engine refuses one it cannot run.
items.title: Statement

statements.title: Statements

statements.sql: SELECT content FROM bot_memory WHERE id = ?
